text: Write the CRC-card exercise as code: a class whose responsibilities fit on one card. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: private final List<Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
explanation: Verified: `78 2`. Three responsibilities, all about the same data, and the card stays small — which is the test. Beck and Cunningham's point was that the physical smallness of an index card is doing real work: a class whose responsibilities do not fit is doing too much, and moving one means physically moving a line, which makes alternatives cheap to try and cheap to abandon.
